snippet.title: Race Jam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474450/Race_Jam/

Introducing Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

- Jam packed with content: Featuring 6 Game Modes, including a full single player campaign with over 99 missions to complete!

- Customize to your playstyle - Build your own RaceKits to enhance your vehicles with upgraded parts, or just to show off the new rims and spoilers you’ve unlocked!

- Race with Friends: Up to 4 players can hop on the couch and race for bragging rights. Or hop online and compete against people from all over the world.

- Easy to race, tough to master: Switch on Dad mode for a fun casual experience. Or more experienced players can use advanced techniques such as boost cancels, perfect boosts and more allow for more skill expression then any racing game that has come before.

https://www.racejamgame.com/

#games #indiegame #indiegames #racing #steam #comingsoon
